subject.title: fix: carry reply metadata into runtime context

question: Should runtime-only turns retain channel-derived reply body/context in the active system-prompt path, or should that content use the same explicitly untrusted runtime-envelope mechanism as ordinary inbound context?
rationale: The branch intentionally changes where reply context is injected, and the changed test demonstrates that replied-to text reaches `session.agent.state.systemPrompt`; only maintainers can set the permanent trust/role contract for this path.

options.title: Use an untrusted runtime envelope
options.body: Keep reply bodies and channel-supplied context out of active system-prompt state, reserving structured trusted metadata for authenticated transport identifiers.

options.title: Approve the system-context contract
options.body: Retain the current runtime-only path only after documenting and testing how its system-prompt representation preserves untrusted-content isolation.

recommendation.title: Use an untrusted runtime envelope
recommendation.body: Keep reply bodies and channel-supplied context out of active system-prompt state, reserving structured trusted metadata for authenticated transport identifiers.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work owns the adjacent current-main runtime-context split and is the closest feature-history signal for the role/trust decision.
